main_text.p: ab eo qui non habet legitimam potefta tem impofita, quantum in ipfo eft omnino declinare. Non modo quia folenne eft τοῖς [illegible, ~14 letters] ad iniquè promittenda eos in quos tyrannidem exercent compellere: fed etiam qui tenetur quisque jus fuum libertatemque pro virili tueri; nec fe facile alienæ tyrannidi in fervitutem tradere. At fecundo, fi præter imperium vis infuper adhibeatur, cui refiftere non poterit, ita ut nullus jam fit fine fummo difcrimine recufandi locus: dicendum poffe virum pium tale juramentum ob vitandum grave incommodum in fe admittere, fed ægrè tamen & gravatè & cum alia reluctantis animi fignificatione, dummodo tamen ipfa juramenti verba (quod in hoc genere rariffimum eft) nihil contineant aut ex fe illicitum, aut legibus publicis contrarium, aut juri alterius cujus tertiæ perfonæ derogatorium: aliàs recufare debere, etiam cum vitæ discrimine, & ultima quæque pati potius quam inhonefto vinculo obligare capu[t]. Dicendum tertiò, qui juramentum su[?]sceperit à perfona juftam authoritatem non habente delatam, fed nulla alia ex parte vitiofam, omnino teneri ad implendum quod juravit.

page.notes: The right edge of the scan cuts off the last letters of most lines, so several words are incomplete (for example "potefta", "tyrannidi", "capu[t]"). The Greek phrase after "folenne eft" is too faint to read and is marked illegible. "At fecundo" is set partly at the cropped edge. "su[?]sceperit" is split across a line end at the edge. The catchword "SECT" is in small capitals at the edge and may be truncated. The strip at the far right is the neighbouring page and was not transcribed.
